CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, February 19, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst

  2. PRESENTATIONS – None

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – January 15th, 2025

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program – Armando Cisneros
  b. Bingo Report – George Borst
  c. Account Balance Update – Armando Cisneros
  d. Monthly Senior Program Fees – Armando Cisneros
  e. Mt. SAC Classes Update- Armando Cisneros
  f. Aging Next – Armando Cisneros
  g. Outstanding Older American – Armando Cisneros
  h. Facilities Report – Yvonne Duran
  i. Upcoming Events – Robyn Olsen
   5. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee meeting will be
  held at 10:00 a.m. on March 19th at the La Verne City Community Center, 3680 D Street,
  La Verne CA 91750.

Posting Statement: On February 13th, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted
on the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website
at www.cityoflaverne.org
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, February 19, 2025

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, February 19, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Jenny Jolly.

  Members Absent: Scott Snider.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Community Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Bette Donovan and seconded by George Borst to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, January 15 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 462 meals were served to an average of 24 participants in
  January.

  Meals on Wheels: N/A.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through January was $894.00.
  liabilities to Bingo West were $374.12. Liabilities to the City of La Verne,
  $442.00. The total number of player attendance for the month of January was
  260.

5. Account Balance: $3,620.72.

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for except Pinochle and Bridge.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Mt. SAC winter session finished on February 14

  Spring session will begin on Monday, February 24th
 8. Aging Next: 4 La Verne Residents were served in January. One was served
  via the Joslyn Center and 3 served via the Aging Next office.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: The roof in SCR is getting checked for leaks that happened
  from the last rain storm.

10. Upcoming Events:

  •  Friday, February 21 – Excursion: Pirates Dinner Adventure, 4:30AM-10:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, February 26– Senior Seminar: A Look at Most Common Cancers, Presented by
  Independence at Home, 9:30AM.
  •  Monday, March 10 – Movie Matinee: The Greatest Showman, 12:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, March 12– Senior Seminar: What You Need to Know When You Leave Your Doctor’s
  Office, Presented by Independence at Home, 9:30AM.
  •  Monday, March 17 – Excursion: Colorful Songs of Broadway, “The Luck O’ the Irish”, 10:45AM-4:30PM.

  Public Comments: George Borst informed the committee of a rise in the number
  of Bingo participants due to some new people from Upland attending. George
  made comments on the history of the Bingo program. He also stated that the
  Golf Club was doing very well. Bette Donovan is reviewing ideas for possibly
  bringing Bunco to the Community Center. She will follow up with Armando.
  Jenny Jolly asked if we could get more details from Aging Next regarding the
  issues they are serving for the residents of La Verne.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:40AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, March 19, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
